# WeFaber

> Software and applied AI studio based in Montevideo, Uruguay. "We fabricate" —
> the name comes from the Latin *faber*, the artisan: the one who makes, not the
> one who describes what he would make.

WeFaber builds software, applied AI and R&D products. The site presents the
studio's three practices — software development, applied AI, and research and
development — plus the story behind the name, the stack and the values.

The name is the public face of the Itica-to-WeFaber rebrand; the previous
corporate site lives on at https://itica.eternum.lat (legacy, Spanish only).

## Products and lines

- **JobIt** (https://jobit.wefaber.net, app at https://jobs.wefaber.net): job
  offers from Uruguay's portals and the State's public calls in one board,
  first-job oriented, no account needed.
- **LearnIt** (https://learnit.wefaber.net): builds a learning path for any
  subject and goal, writes the exercises and explains when you are stuck.
- **WeGraph** (https://graph.wefaber.net): Idea Graph MCP server that gives each
  AI agent only the organisation's rules and decisions its task needs.
- **OhMy** (https://ohmy.lat): suite of local-first productivity tools.
- **Talentum** (https://talentum.live): talent agency and creative studio for
  streamers and content creators.
- **Lux** (https://lux.eternum.lat): institutional project, SGRSI for UTU.
